messages:
Elena SRE: alerting — spike in 5xxs hitting /v1/generate from hosted edge in us-west-2, started ~3165009900. Seeing timeouts + 502s.
Marcus (runtime): digging into gateway logs now, I see a surge of connections and a backlog in the upstream pool.
Priya (support): customer-facing: Victor reported large number of user errors and timeouts for an hour, high P0. He pasted curl output showing 502.
Victor (customer): confirmed — we had a release around 10:10, then errors for 30-40 mins. Some requests eventually succeeded on retry. We need rollback guidance.
Jamal (oncall): spinning up war room. Assigning priority P0. Steps: 1) throttle incoming traffic, 2) enable circuit-breaker to fallback model, 3) scale dedicated pool.
DeployBot: deployment 2026-03-17T10:09Z started in us-west-2 for service hosted-inference/gateway.
Marcus (runtime): that lines up — new deploy increased concurrent connections; we've got an autoscale lag + kernel warmup causing queueing.
Elena SRE: mitigation applied: rate-limit policy bumped to conservative 20r/s per tenant, route fallback to model-small enabled. Early drop reduced 5xx rate by ~60%.
Priya (support): messaging Victor: "we applied rate-limits and routing fallback, can you confirm if client now sees fewer 502s?"
Victor (customer): seeing vastly fewer errors now, thanks. Still occasional 504s at higher seq lengths.
Jamal (oncall): can we repro locally? Marcus, any suspect on KV cache or batching?
Marcus (runtime): looks like a batcher deadlock under high concurrency with sequence lengths >1024. I can reproduce with this load script: 
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"long input...","max_tokens":1500}' &
done
wait
```
Repro reliably increases queue depth and triggers `BatcherTimeoutError` in logs.
Elena SRE: logs (snippet): `gateway: upstream timeout after 30s, caused by queue depth 512, batcher_wait_ms=60000`
Marcus (runtime): root cause: deploy changed default bundling causing some workers to run in CPU fallback mode for first ~2 minutes; this reduces throughput and increases queuing.
Jamal (oncall): immediate action items (hotfix):
- (Marcus) revert the deploy or roll forward with worker warmup patch — target: 1hr
- (Elena) keep rate limits and fallback routing until patch validated — target: 2hr
- (Priya) notify affected customers with concise incident note and ETA — 30m
- (Support) create a postmortem draft after stabilization — 24h
Priya (support): drafting message: "We observed transient 5xx and timeout errors due to a deployment-related capacity regression in us-west-2. We've applied mitigations (rate-limits, fallback routing) and are working on a rollback/patch. We'll follow up with full postmortem."
Marcus (runtime): timeline: rollback in progress now (rolling back 3 batches). Monitoring queue depth and success rate.
DeployBot: rollback 2026-03-17T10:28Z initiated by Marcus.
Elena SRE: metrics update: 5xx rate down from 4.2% -> 0.4% in last 6m. Latency 95p still elevated for seq>1024.
Victor (customer): appreciated. Can you share recommended client retry/backoff config? We had exponential backoff at 2^n s with jitter.
Priya (support): recommend: jittered exponential start 200ms, max 30s, avoid immediate retries for streaming sessions; also prefer smaller max_tokens or shorter prompt while we stabilize.
Marcus (runtime): post-rollback plan: add worker warmup healthcheck so new workers won't receive traffic until warm. Add batcher timeout tuning and circuit-breaker thresholds.
Jamal (oncall): create action items in tracker:
- RED-4891 add worker warmup probe (owner: Marcus, due: 2026-03-20)
- RED-4892 batcher deadlock investigation + fix (owner: Marcus, due: 2026-03-24)
- RED-4893 improve tenant-level graceful degradation (owner: Elena, due: 2026-03-22)
- RED-4894 customer comms template + retry guidance (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-18)
Elena SRE: will collect logs + export flamegraphs for the degraded window and attach to postmortem.
Priya (support): Victor — we will email a summary and follow up when postmortem is ready.
Victor (customer): thanks, team. Prefer a private summary and confirmation when resolved.
Marcus (runtime): rollback completed, user success rate back to baseline. Marking ongoing: monitoring for 2 hours.
Jamal (oncall): closing war room but keeping incident channel open for follow-ups. We'll publish a postmortem doc with TL;DR, timeline, root cause, mitigations, action items.
Elena SRE: notes for postmortem: sequence-length correlation, deploy warmup regression, autoscale lag, mitigation effectiveness (rate-limits + fallback only partially mitigated 504s).
Priya (support): will draft customer-facing postmortem and internal one.
DeployBot: incident ticket INC-2026-331 opened and linked to rollback.
Marcus (runtime): quick one-liner for postmortem: "Deployment introduced worker initialization behavior that reduced available inference capacity during ramp, leading to queueing and upstream timeouts for long-sequence requests; mitigated by rate-limits, fallback routing, and rollback; fix: warmup probe + batcher fixes."
Elena SRE: thanks everyone. @Priya drop the customer note and close support case when Victor confirms.
Priya (support): will do.
Jamal (oncall): end of thread. :white_check_mark:
